segments.contextBefore: Use Live Caller ID Lookup to protect user privacy by hiding the client’s IP address, using anonymous authentication, and hiding the incoming phone number.
segments.contextAfter: The Live Caller ID Lookup feature allows you to check incoming calls against your server for known spam numbers while preserving user privacy.

segments.contextAfter: When someone’s device receives a phone call, the system communicates with your back-end server to retrieve caller ID and blocking information, and then displays that information on the incoming call screen and in the device’s recent calls.
